mapper.select: SELECT id, alert_instance_id AS alert_instance_id, report_id, rule_code, notify_content AS content, event_type, created_at, sent_at AS delivered_at FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type = 'NOTIFICATION' AND notify_channel = 'IN_APP' AND notify_status = 'DELIVERED' AND target_user_id = #{user} AND id < #{before} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type = 'NOTIFICATION' AND notify_channel = 'IN_APP' AND notify_status = 'DELIVERED' AND target_user_id = #{user}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_alert_notification WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'NOTIFICATION' AND notify_channel = 'IN_APP' AND notify_status = 'DELIVERED' AND target_user_id = #{user}

SELECT DISTINCT alert_instance_id FROM t_alert_notification WHERE record_type = 'NOTIFICATION' AND notify_channel = 'IN_APP' AND notify_status = 'DELIVERED' AND target_user_id = #{user} AND alert_instance_id IN #{id} AND COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(notify_content, '$.eventType')), event_type, '') IN ('ALERT_FIRED', 'ALERT_ESCALATION')
